subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should `deferred` and the reply-runtime lifecycle callback become permanent public cron/plugin contracts, or should the yielded-parent repair remain internal until a broader lifecycle model is approved?
rationale: The bug repair is valid, but the PR also creates persisted, Gateway, CLI, UI, hook, and Plugin SDK contract surface whose permanent ownership requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve public lifecycle contract
options.body: Keep `deferred` and the SDK callback, require upgrade proof, and document downstream exhaustive-handling requirements.

options.title: Narrow to internal lifecycle state
options.body: Repair yielded-parent behavior without making the new status and callback permanent public contracts yet.

options.title: Pause for unified lifecycle design
options.body: Hold the PR until cron, gateway session, task, and channel owners agree on one cross-surface state model.

recommendation.title: Narrow to internal lifecycle state
recommendation.body: Repair yielded-parent behavior without making the new status and callback permanent public contracts yet.

likelyOwner.reason: Merged history shows the broadest ownership signal across the affected Discord, agent, cron, and SDK lifecycle surfaces.
